description: Verify that a physical item is genuine by checking its Aeroz chip UID and cryptographic signature. Use this before trusting any claim about a physical unit — a database record proves a record exists, not that the object in front of you is the one it describes. Returns verified:false with a reason and NO product data when the signature does not match.

signature.description: The HMAC signature from the tag payload (the `t` parameter).

uid.description: The chip UID read from the NFC tag or QR payload.

name: verify_chip
